'''Rosser Weno''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who lived approximately thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
Rosser Weno was present when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entered the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]], and the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

Shortly after Solo, Rey, Finn, and BB-8's arrival, Weno and the rest of the castle's patrons rushed outside to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]], which was caused by [[Starkiller Base]], a [[superweapon]] that had been built by the [[First Order]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Personality and traits==
Rosser had dark skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]]. He wore armor made from [[Battle droid|combat droid]] plating on his right shoulder and a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] power brace on his left [[Limb|arm]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rosser Weno first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]].<ref name="TFA" /> While Weno was not identified in the film, his name was revealed in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> Rosser was portrayed by [[Elroy Powell]] in the film.
